title: Claude Code plugin.json
description: Schema for a plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest. Field set follows https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference.md — intentionally covers only fields this marketplace's tooling relies on; unknown extra fields are tolerated for forward-compatibility.

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier, matches the plugin's directory name.

description.description: Required by this repo's own convention (stricter than upstream) so the generated marketplace catalog always has a description.

kind.description: Non-upstream, catalog-only hint (see docs/decisions/adr-0001-marketplace-distribution-model.md) so the generator/README can label single-component plugins distinctly from multi-component bundles. Ignored by Claude Code itself.
